LICENSE.txt reproduces the MIT copyright and permission text in the upstream

both C++ source files and UPSTREAM-README.markdown.

Integration: app/src/invite_qr.cpp validates a Tox invitation using the existing
Core API, encodes its complete canonical tox: URI at medium error correction,
and returns a row-major black/white module snapshot. It does not contact any
service. The renderer must add a white quiet zone of at least four modules on
every side and draw square modules at an integer pixel scale.
